scripts.deploy: gcloud builds submit --tag us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/tryhard-word-games/apps/get-word-game-answers && gcloud run deploy get-word-game-answers --image us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/tryhard-word-games/apps/get-word-game-answers --region us-central1 --memory 2Gi --cpu 1 --timeout 300 --no-allow-unauthenticated --set-env-vars NODE_ENV=production
scripts.logs: gcloud run services logs read get-word-game-answers --region us-central1 --limit 50
